constraints: Both long and short. Completed-bar crossover; next-bar-open fill. Long: fast SMA crosses above slow SMA. Short: fast crosses below. Exit on opposite crossover or fixed atr_stop: lookback=20, multiplier=2.0, entry_ref=next_bar_open_pre_fee_slippage, evaluation_price=close, evaluation_timing=bar_close. One position, 1.0 leverage, no pyramiding, max hold, take profit, regime filter, or adaptive sizing. Fees 4bps, slippage 2bps, funding accounted. Only free parameters: fast [30,50,70] default 50 and slow [150,200,250] default 200; require fast<slow. H-004 remains NO-GO.
input.idea: H-004-R1 daily dual-SMA trend with fixed ATR risk containment. BTCUSDT daily medium-term trend exposure may retain positive risk-adjusted behavior when a simple dual-SMA crossover is paired with a fixed completed-bar ATR risk exit. The candidate removes the H-004 rolling volatility-percentile gate and tests whether fixed ATR(20) x 2.0 risk containment can reduce drawdown without creating post-hoc side selection, hidden leverage, or extra free parameters.
